_______________________
Experience the best of Southern Vietnam in 7 days with this complete travel itinerary. From the modern, chaotic streets of Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon) to the cooler, cozy atmosphere of Da Lat, this guide shows you two completely different sides of Vietnam.

After spending over a year living and traveling across Vietnam, I’ve put together this itinerary based on real experiences — including cafés, temples, local food, hidden spots, and everyday moments.

_______________________
Hotels we stayed at and can recommend:

What to Expect:
Explore Saigon’s cafés, apartment buildings, Book Street, and temples
Discover Nguyễn Huệ Walking Street & the famous Coffee Apartment Building
Try local food, egg coffee, bánh mì, and more
Experience Saigon’s nightlife and jazz bars
Travel to Da Lat and explore its pine forests, temples, and scenic viewpoints
Visit unique cafés, flower gardens, and local hidden gems
End the trip with Vietnamese BBQ and city views
